text:
maya_support: Vendor (CloudFoundry Solutions) flagged a proration + surge protection question. They reserved 10 nodes starting 2026-06-10 but were charged full-day burst on 06/10 for a small 3-hour spike. They ask why no proration or surge cap applied.

ben_fin: Put invoice and pool id please. We'll check commitment start date handling and surge protection thresholds.

maya_support: INV-2026-0610, pool cf-sol-10, ticket CFV-2201. Billing snippet:
```
Invoice: INV-2026-0610
Period: 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-30
 - Reserved capacity (cf-sol-10): effective 2026-06-10 - 10 nodes - $20,000
 - Burst usage (burst-unallocated): 3 node-hours on 06/10 - $45
Total: $20,045
```

metering-bot: Quick note: reserved commit start dates are applied at midnight UTC of effective date; usage earlier on same day can be pro-rated only if commitment start time matches invoice logic.

raj_ops: I checked the pool activation event: the commit was recorded at 15:00 UTC on 06/10 (customer UI time). Our billing job uses start-of-day UTC for commit proration; because the activation occurred after the billing window threshold, the small spike at 02:00 UTC was considered unreserved -> billed as burst.

olivia_sales: Customer expects commits to protect them from intra-day spikes once the reservation day starts. Can we do a customer-facing explanation + consider an exception for same-day activations where a small spike preceded official activation by <24h?

ben_fin: Finance policy: we do not automatically retro-prorate for activations logged after threshold. But discretion allowed for < $500 and if vendor impact minimal. Propose invoice correction of $45 as goodwill and note that we'll adjust docs to clarify activation timing. Need revops ticket to record decision.

lina_revops: I'll log revops-927 and attach meter rows.

maya_support: Draft reply: "Thanks — the reserved pool activated at 15:00 UTC on 2026-06-10, so a short spike at 02:00 UTC happened before the commit was active in billing. We've issued a $45 invoice credit as a one-time exception and updated docs on activation timing. Sorry for the confusion."

ben_fin: Approved. Creating credit memo CM-2026-401 ($45, reason: SAME_DAY_ACTIVATION_EXCEPTION). AP to post to June ledger.

metering-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-401 created and queued.

olivia_sales: Customer replied: "Appreciate the quick fix and the doc clarification." :thumbsup:

ben_fin: AP posted credit. Closing CFV-2201. Thanks team.
